heidi_find_and_manage_projects_content: It’s easier to find the projects when you organize them into workspaces using Label Studio Enterprise.
heidi_faster_provisioning_content: Streamline assigning staff to multiple projects by assigning them to workspaces in Label Studio Enterprise.
heidi_annotator_dashboard_content: In the Enterprise platform, admins can view annotator performance dashboards to optimize resource allocation, improve team management, and inform compensation.
heidi_access_to_projects_content: You can control access to specific projects and workspaces for internal team members and external annotators using Label Studio Enterprise.
heidi_templates_content: You can use or modify dozens or templates to configure your labeling UI, or create a custom configuration from scratch using simple XML-like tag.
heidi_genai_templates_content: Label Studio has templates available for supervised LLM fine-tuning, RAG retrieval ranking, RLHF, chatbot evaluation, and more.
heidi_team_growing_title: It looks like your team is growing!
heidi_team_growing_content: Assign roles to your team using Label Studio Enterprise and control access to sensitive data at the project and workspace levels.
heidi_enable_sso_title: Want to simplify and secure logging in?
heidi_enable_sso_content: Enable Single Sign-On for your team using SAML, SCIM2 or LDAP with Label Studio Enterprise.
heidi_starter_cloud_live_content: Try Label Studio Starter Cloud, optimized for small teams and projects.
heidi_automate_distribution_content: Create rules, automate how tasks are distributed to annotators, and only show tasks assigned to each annotator in their view.and control task visibility for each annotator.
heidi_share_knowledge_content: Have questions or a tip to share with other Label Studio users? Join the community slack channel for the latest updates.
heidi_integration_points_content: Label Studio supports multiple points of integration with cloud storage, machine learning models, and popular tools to automate your machine learning pipeline.
heidi_aws_marketplace_title: Apply your AWS spend to Label Studio Enterprise
heidi_aws_marketplace_content: Label Studio Enterprise is now available on the AWS Marketplace so you can use your committed spend to streamline data labeling workflows.
heidi_auto_labeling_content: Use automation to instantly label large-scale datasets without sacrificing quality in the Enterprise platform.
heidi_quality_and_agreement_content: You can increase the quality of your labeled data with reviewer workflows and task agreement scores using Label Studio Enterprise.
heidi_evals_content: Combine automation plus human supervision to evaluate and ensure LLM quality in the Enterprise platform.
heidi_infrastructure_and_upgrades_conten: You can save time managing infrastructure and upgrades, plus access more features for automation, quality, and team management, by using the Enterprise cloud service.
heidi_connect_ml_models_content: You can connect ML models using the backend SDK to save time with pre-labeling or active learning.
